source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 20, 2026, there were 792,449,940 shares of common stock, $5.00 par value, issued and outstanding.

notes: Common stock only, listed on the New York Stock Exchange as BA. The 5,750,000 shares of 6.00% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock (liquidation preference $1,000 each, mandatory conversion into common stock by October 15, 2027) are preferred stock and are left out. The Q3 2026 10-Q cover (filed October 27, 2026) is the latest count, newer than the FY2025 10-K cover (785,347,096 at January 23, 2026).
